items.title: Agentic Video Studio
items.description: A prompt-guided video-production prototype combining semantic retrieval, planning, timestamped segment selection, and automated rendering to turn personal media into social-ready edits.
items.detail: Hybrid BM25–FAISS retrieval and a responsive thumbnail-first media experience, with optimized analysis, caching, and independent pipeline stages to reduce repeat processing and improve compute utilization.

items.title: LLM TokenWatch
items.description: An internal observability tool for understanding model usage and projected demand.
items.detail: Event-driven incremental monitoring, per-model token aggregation, restart recovery, and role-specific dashboards for usage trends.
